reference_strategy: One digit and one face per image, ten separate AI references; no composite reference matching.

left.scope: Only original exposed skin vertices. Original glove, trim, nails, wrist, rig, topology and UV retained.
left.corrective_method: Same local Basis offset added to all fifteen relative keys; original correction vectors preserved.

thumb_nail_placement.reason: User identified low, elongated thumb nail placement.
thumb_nail_placement.method: Shorten footprint from proximal side, place as close to tip as the actual skin ray footprint permits, and center across actual skin section; seat on skin in following step.

thumb.method: Native +Z projected perpendicular to distal bone axis; paired top/bottom equal outward-only shift; axial and cross-plane coordinates retained.
